deadline.value: Applicants outside the US must apply by November 30; applicants in the US by December 1.
deadline.quote: All applications from students who are not currently in the United States are due by November 30th.

gre_general.value: The GRE is no longer required.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is no longer required for admission.

ielts_min.value: The program asks for IELTS Academic 7.0.
ielts_min.quote: 7.0 on the IELTS Academic test or IELTS Indicator

fee_waiver.value: Waivers are for domestic applicants; international applicants already in the US can get one, those abroad cannot.
fee_waiver.quote: Unfortunately, the NGP does not offer fee waivers to students who are not in the United States at the time of application.

also.quote: International students who are already in the United States at the time of application are eligible for fee waivers.

supervisor.value: You do not need to secure an advisor before applying, though contacting faculty is strongly encouraged; students rotate before choosing a lab.
supervisor.quote: Applicants are not required to finalize an advisor before I applying.

funding.value: The program is fully funded, mostly through Graduate Research Associate appointments with tuition, health insurance and a stipend.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's from an accredited institution is required.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must have or will have a Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the pages checked
